gold.gold_rationale: The pre-2024-11-06 clause (h) requires uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or on receipt of updated information, with NO time-bound deadline. T6KYC03 normalizes the customer name and sets the upload flag on any non-blank name (lines 17-20) with no deadline concept. There is no elapsed-time or deadline gate anywhere in the program, consistent with an obligation that has no deadline to violate.
